notes.title: Refrega Launch - Early Access
notes.content:
Dear Steam community players,

It is with great pleasure that we announce the Early Access launch of Refrega, an innovative real-time strategy game, available from March 12, 2024. In Refrega, you will have the opportunity to build bases, defend territories, and win challenging battles.

Key Features:

[b]Build and Strengthen Bases:[/b] Create impregnable fortifications and develop resources to sustain your military operations.

[b]Defend Your Territories:[/b] Protect your lands from invaders and maintain your supremacy against enemy attacks.

[b]Command Troops with Cunning:[/b] Show your tactical skills by positioning and commanding your units on the battlefield.

We invite all strategists and strategy game enthusiasts to dive into this immersive experience. Refrega is not just a game, it is a test of your quickness, cunning, and adaptability in scenarios that are constantly changing.

Prepare for an action-packed journey to the top of the strategic hierarchy. Are you ready to take command?

Join us on the battlefield on March 12, 2024.

We appreciate your ongoing support and look forward to seeing you in Refrega. Get ready to build, defend, and conquer!

Best regards,

Datyus
Refrega Developer"
